themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Articles discussing AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, analyze data, or act as research assistants.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Content focused on AI tools that help developers write, debug, and understand code, specifically for research purposes.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Articles about AI's ability to condense large amounts of text, data, or video into concise summaries for research insights.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Discussions on various AI tools and platforms designed to aid researchers in their work, from data collection to analysis.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Content exploring how AI is being integrated into the design process and user research workflows to enhance creativity and efficiency.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Articles examining how AI is changing job roles, skill requirements, and the overall employment landscape within research and design fields.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Discussions on the creation and use of simulated user data or personas for testing and research purposes.

themes.name: AI research tools comparison
themes.description: Articles that compare different AI tools and platforms for research, evaluating their features, performance, and suitability.

themes.name: AI qualitative research
themes.description: Content focusing on how AI can assist in qualitative data analysis, interviews, and understanding nuanced human behavior.

themes.name: AI sentiment feedback
themes.description: Articles discussing the use of AI to analyze and understand user sentiment, emotions, and feedback from various sources.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
